'''DATA'''
* '''Added: MH-80 (Assault) Ghost Hawk'''
* '''Added: MH-80 DAP (Direct Action Penetrator) Ghost Hawk'''
* '''Added: ECM Pod (laser and flare variants) pylon attachment'''
* '''Added: Radar Pod pylon attachment'''
* '''Added: Camera Pod pylon attachment'''
* '''Added: Searchlight Pod (with / without IR) pylon attachment'''
* '''Added: 12.7 mm Minigun pylon weapon'''
* Added: Black / Dazzle (sand) / Dazzle (tropic) variants of various pylon attachments
* Added: H-80 external fuel tank jettisoning
* Added: H-80 Vehicle-in-Vehicle transport (small objects)
* Added: MH-80 extending fuel probe (visual only)
* Added: MH-80 Assault Firing From Vehicles seats on the door edges
* Fixed: Missing PhysX geometry in the tail section of Ghost Hawk
* Fixed: Incorrect sound set was used for the T-100X railgun - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T199641|FT-T199641}}

'''ENGINE'''
* Fixed: When a PhysX object repeatedly falls below terrain, it will now be put on top and put to sleep to prevent it from falling again
* Added Ability to log ''#monitords'' data to BattlEye RCon independently of server console 
* Added: All remaining difficulty options to [[Description.ext#DifficultyOverride|description.ext DifficultyOverride]]
* Added: Preprocessor [[PreProcessor_Commands#Variadic_Arguments|variadic arguments]]
* Added: ''showBackpack'' config entry to vehicle seats 'spec' (''PilotSpec'', ''CargoSpec'', next to ''showHeadPhones'')
* Fixed: Error "SetConstantColor not supported" when drawing IR lasers
* Fixed: Incorrect instancing for non-weapon pylon attachments
* Fixed: Non-weapon pylon attachments with a light reflector would incorrectly show the light as active when placed in Eden Editor
* Added: Pylon ''CameraComponent'' can now override vehicle driver / turret ''weaponInfoType'' with a ''cameraInfoType'' entry
* Added: Preprocessor now reports "too many" / "too few" macro argument errors (previously they were silent errors)
